concepts.name: 01-inset-header
concepts.prompt: Edit this reference screenshot into ONE polished dark-mode Windows desktop UI concept for AI Token Scrooge's timeline section. Wide landscape panel, sharp legible Segoe-style typography. Keep the existing dark charcoal, lavender quota-refresh icons, amber reset-expiry icons, OpenAI and GitHub marks with Pro/Plus mini badges, all 13 equally spaced day ticks Today Oct25 through Fri Nov6, and same-day stacked events. Preserve the timeline concept, DO NOT create another app/dashboard or show account meters. User dislikes the detached oversized title above the card. Integrate the smaller 'Reset Horizon' title into the timeline card. Retain an actionable '3 Codex resets available' button on the RIGHT and readable 'Earliest expiry Oct 29 · 2:39 PM' underneath it. Keep subtle compact legend 'Quota refresh' with purple dot and 'Reset expires' with amber dot, plus 'Hover or click for details'. No floating external headline. Output a single beautiful full-width section mockup, not a collage. Concept 1: unified rounded card with a compact internal top toolbar. Small Reset Horizon title aligned top-left INSIDE the card, legend beside title. Reset-count button top-right within same card with small expiry text directly under button. Thin subtle divider below toolbar, daily timeline beneath. Comfortable tight vertical spacing. This is the faithful elegant integrated header option.
